summary: Embraer S.A. filed a Form 6-K furnishing an English-language manual and management proposal for an Extraordinary General Shareholders Meeting (EGM) to be held October 30, 2026, at 10 AM, exclusively via Microsoft Teams. The package includes the call notice, bylaws voting provisions, remote-voting guidance, and annexes covering a protocol and justification, appraiser information, and an appraisal report — pointing to a proposed merger to be voted. No price, stake, premium, or advisor is disclosed in the excerpt; watch for the merger's exchange ratio and dissent/appraisal risk.
